issues: No price changes or dead links: all five load-bearing items re-verified 2026-07-31 at the researchers' prices (kit $34.97, Heltec V3 $26.97, battery $29.95, ML-70F $48.13, 200W panel $169.99).
polycase.com returns HTTP 403 to direct automated fetches; ML-70F price/stock re-confirmed via r.jina.ai reader proxy (same method the enclosure researcher used) — the URL itself is live, not dead.

RF interconnect gap in relay/gateway BOMs as specified: the Proxicast bulkhead arrestor is N-female on BOTH sides and the antenna base is also N-female, so mating them requires an N-male-to-N-male barrel adapter or short jumper (~$5-10, not in any researcher's list). Alternative: skip the arrestor and screw the included N-male pigtail directly onto the antenna, but then you lose lightning protection and the sealed feedthrough.

Altelix pole mount ($21.99): product page advertises same-day shipping but the cart showed a 'Contact Us for Availability' prompt on 2026-07-31 — confirm stock at order time or fall back to Altelix's Amazon storefront.
Adafruit battery has a 10+ quantity break at $26.96/unit — relevant if ordering 10 or more solar relays (BOM keeps the verified 1-unit price of $29.95 per instructions).
Kiosk radio count is 22 but the recommended charging station has 20 ports; 2 radios rotate or charge from the station in shifts — flagged in case a 2nd station or a 24-port unit is preferred.
Renogy 200W multi-packs are cheaper per panel ($338.81/2, $656.46/4) if multiple off-grid kiosks are built; BOM uses the verified 1-pack price.
